name: Suiren
source:
"Now is the time to fulfill the promise we made a thousand years ago. I missed you, my bride."

A snake god who disappeared around the same time that Ameyori Terasutokoshi Enokami disappeared. He doesn't even have a shred of empathy for youkai, but shows affection and mercy towards human because they're "cute."

He is shown to be obsessed with Kuro and tries to make her be his bride. 

[Translated from [url=http://mikatuki.sakura.ne.jp/m/contents/character/img/chara_suiren.png]official website[/url]]

One of Kuro's love interests.
